messages:
elaine: Heads-up: I'm drafting the v1->v2 migration guidance for models and client shims. Key decisions needed: redirect behavior, example snippets in SDKs, and whether to keep an opt-in compat flag. Link to draft: https://redwood.dev/r/4189

sam: For redirects: prefer 307 for POSTs to preserve method, 301 for GETs. We should also emit an `X-Deprecated: v1` header for telemetry.

anya: Agreed on 307 for POSTs. I'll prepare TS and Python snippets that show the new client and the compat shim usage. Note: users confuse `model` vs `model:` fields in examples.

diego: I'll add a smoke test to the compat suite. Suggest we map `redwood-lite-v1` -> `redwood-lite-v2-compat` as fallback. I have a branch for tests.

elaine: Draft nginx rule in PR:
```
# preserve method for POST
location /v1/ {
  proxy_pass http://upstream/v2/;
  proxy_set_header X-Deprecated "v1";
  return 307;
}
```
Need to decide on query preservation and exact path rewrites.

sam: that rule will always 307; prefer conditional rewrite. Also avoid returning before proxy_pass. Example rewrite approach:
```
rewrite ^/v1/(.*)$ /v2/$1 redirect;
```
Which yields 302/301 depending on flags.

anya: TS SDK snippet for docs: 
```
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2' });
await client.models.list();
```
Add note: `new Redwood({compat:true})` will translate v1 calls for ~90 days only.

diego: Smoke test PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/smoke/pull/92. CI failing on auth header; pushing fix now.

elaine: Owners: sam -> redirect rules + infra changes, anya -> SDK snippets + examples, diego -> tests. I'll add a deprecation banner draft to the docs homepage and the banner copy to the PR. Quick sync tomorrow 10am PST to sign off.


docs-bot: PR #4189 opened by @elaine in docs-staging.

sam: I'll run a grep across quickstarts/console for hard `/v1/` links and file redirects where needed.

anya: Can someone add a curl example showing Location + X-Deprecated headers when hitting v1? Small snippet helps support.

diego: Tests green after auth fix. Merged smoke test to compat branch.

elaine: Thanks all. Please review PR and leave comments by EOD so we can schedule rollout next week.
